children: Overview
Canada outdoor-lifestyle brand's fiscal Q2 sales fell 2.4% yr/yr, impacted by store closure
Adjusted EBITDA loss for Q2 improved 26% yr/yr
Company agreed to be acquired by Marquee Brands in previously announced deal
Outlook
Roots expects acquisition by Marquee Brands to close in Q4 2026
Company says it is positioned to scale operations in the second half of the yr
Result Drivers
STORE CLOSURE IMPACT - Temporary closure of flagship Whistler store for relocation reduced DTC sales, per company
DISTRIBUTION CENTRE TRANSITION - Incremental costs and delays from transition to new distribution centre weighed on sales and margins
WHOLESALE AND LICENSING WEAKNESS - Lower wholesale sales to international partner and timing shifts in licensing royalties reduced P&O sales

The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
